en.t: Why is it called a takabata, a high loom?

units.source_text: 不言而喻，就是因为它是高架手织机。

en.t: The reason is obvious: it is a handloom set up on a raised frame.

units.source_text: 一说是由于手织机安放在挖得很浅的地面上，地里的潮气对丝有好处，所以叫高机。

en.t: One explanation says it was called a high loom because the handloom was set over ground that had been dug out shallowly, and the moisture from the earth was good for the silk thread.

units.source_text: 原先有人坐在高机上，现在还有人把沉重的石头装进篮子里，然后吊在高机旁边。

en.t: In the past someone would sit on the high loom; even now some people put heavy stones into baskets and hang them beside the loom.
